name: The Creature
source:
When Frankenstein's "evil" creation approaches you, what will you do? Will you show him kindness, or will you treat him the same as his so-called father?

Will you perhaps, love him?

[From [url=https://hoodieratboi.itch.io/the-creature]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当弗兰肯斯坦创造出的那个“邪恶”造物走到你面前时，你会怎么做？你会向他施以善意，还是像他那位所谓的父亲一样冷酷待他？

又或者，你会爱上他吗？

[摘自[url=https://hoodieratboi.itch.io/the-creature]itch.io[/url]]
